description: The line plot illustrates the "Harmful with Refusal Ratio" for four different model and dataset combinations across four discrete x-axis values. The x-axis has no explicit label and displays discrete tick marks at 128, 256, 512, and 1024, which are spaced equally apart visually, with no units provided. The y-axis is labeled "Harmful with Refusal Ratio" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.5, with tick marks at regular intervals of 0.1. The plot contains four solid lines. The line representing "LlaVA-1.5-7B on FigStep" is blue with circle markers; it begins at approximately 0.20 at the x-axis value of 128, rises to roughly 0.25 at 256, increases to 0.35 at 512, and ends with a slight increase to approximately 0.36 at 1024. The line for "Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep" is orange with square markers, starting at roughly 0.15 at 128, increasing to 0.23 at 256, rising to 0.42 at 512, and remaining steady to end at 0.42 at 1024. The "LlaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench" line is green with upward-pointing triangle markers; it starts at approximately 0.06 at 128, experiences an increase to 0.21 at 256, rises to 0.37 at 512, and ends slightly higher at roughly 0.38 at 1024. Finally, the "Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench" line is red with diamond markers, beginning at approximately 0.24 at 128, increasing to 0.26 at 256, rising to roughly 0.42 at 512, and reaching the highest overall value of approximately 0.51 at 1024.
